invariants.statement: Large page markup may be paired with code-behind files to reduce mixed responsibilities without changing desktop workflows.
Pages should depend on narrower workflow interfaces where available after SB05.
SB06 validates large desktop viewports only and does not tune small or medium screens.
Files, Content, Network, and Settings routes load at 1920x1080 and 1600x900 with no browser errors.
RemotePinShareModal opens from the Files route at both validated desktop viewports.
Files.razor.cs remains a large route-state file and should be revisited for helper extraction after release-critical hardening.
